statement: For every 99-by-99 symmetric binary zero-diagonal matrix A with exactly 14 ones in each integer row, let D=A^2+A-12I-2J and let H be the simple graph of all nonzero unordered off-diagonal entries of D modulo 3, with isolated vertices discarded. If H is nonempty and connected, then H cannot simultaneously have at most 12 vertices and maximum degree at most 3. This is a necessary residual-support restriction only; it makes no assertion about disconnected supports, larger supports, support degree at least 4 or target existence.

scope.description: Universal conditional necessary restriction on the complete simple symmetric zero-diagonal degree14 adjacency domain of order99: its whole nonempty connected residual support cannot be subcubic on at most12 nonisolated vertices. No assumption of adjacency-graph connectivity or automorphism.

assumptions: A has order99, symmetric binary entries, zero diagonal and exact integer degree14.
Every unordered residual and complete integer row is included.
The conditional premise concerns the whole nonempty connected nonisolated support H, with maximum degree at most3 and at most12 vertices; no premise is imposed on connectivity of A.
